_meta.description: Visualize your debt payoff journey with satisfying burn animations. Plan payment schedules, track progress, and achieve debt freedom with complete privacy.
_title: Embr - Plan Your Path to Debt Freedom
beautiful-intuitive-interface-that.42070: Beautiful, intuitive interface that makes debt planning straightforward. No complexity, just clarity on your path to freedom.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
clean-private-and-motivating.c9628d: Clean, private, and motivating way to plan your debt freedom
complete-privacy-all-processing.d1d881: Complete privacy—all processing happens on your device. No tracking, no cloud servers, no data sharing. Your finances stay private.
does-embr-collect-my.e7c901: Does Embr collect my financial data?
embr-is-a-debt.d77812: Embr is a debt payoff estimation tool that helps you visualize when you'll be debt-free. Enter your debts and try various payment schedules to see how different scenarios affect your timeline. The burn visualization makes tracking progress satisfying and motivating.
embr-s-unique-burn.c21148: Embr's unique burn visualization shows your debts literally burning away as you make payments. The visual feedback is oddly satisfying and keeps you motivated throughout your debt-free journey. Simple and clean UI makes the whole experience enjoyable.
embr-s-unique-burn.c9231a: Embr's unique burn visualization turns debt payoff into something tangible and satisfying. Each payment you make literally burns away a portion of your debt with beautiful fire animations.
embr-supports-various-payment.f49fcf: Embr supports various payment schedules to help you estimate different debt payoff scenarios. Adjust payment amounts and frequencies to find the plan that works best for your budget and timeline.
estimate-when-you-ll.e05600: Estimate when you'll be debt-free with flexible payment schedules and satisfying burn visualizations. Simple, clean interface with complete privacy—all your data stays on your device and syncs via iCloud.
everything-runs-on-your.2a037f: Everything runs on your device with zero data collection. No servers, no tracking, no sharing your financial information with anyone. Your debt details stay completely private.
how-does-embr-help.6c35e5: How does Embr help me plan debt payoff?
keep-your-payoff-progress.288eec: Keep your payoff progress and next payment due in sight with home screen and lock screen widgets. They surface in the Smart Stack around payment due dates and tap straight into the app.
log-a-payment-check.b1e14c: Log a payment, check a debt's balance or payoff date, get your total debt, and read or update your extra-payment settings — all from Shortcuts and Siri, ready for your own automations.
monitor-your-progress-from.a5893c: Monitor your progress from any device. Your debt plans sync seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud.
no-embr-collects-zero.b453dc: No! Embr collects zero data. Everything runs on your device with complete privacy. No tracking, no servers, no sharing your financial information with anyone. Your debt details stay completely private.
no-embr-is-a.d397ef: No! Embr is a one-time purchase that works across all your Apple devices—iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Buy once and use forever with no recurring subscription fees.
one-time-purchase-works.0e2d0e: One-time purchase works across all your Apple devices—iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No subscription fees, own it forever.
payoff-progress-rings-for.f2eaaf: Payoff progress rings for your total and each debt, a Smart Stack complication, and on-wrist payment logging — pick a debt, dial in the amount with the Digital Crown, confirm. Syncs through the same encrypted iCloud pipeline as the iPhone app, no phone required nearby.
plan-with-various-payment.0f214a: Plan with various payment schedules to see when you'll be debt-free. Estimate different scenarios to find what works for your budget.

sync-across-all-your.9dbf7d: Sync across all your Apple devices via iCloud for secure access anywhere. Buy once and use forever on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with no subscription fees.
the-visual-feedback-is.0e27d6: The visual feedback is oddly satisfying and incredibly motivating. Watch your financial burdens turn to ash as you make progress toward freedom.
try-different-payment-schedules.11b978: Try different payment schedules to estimate when you'll be debt-free. Adjust amounts, frequencies, and see how each scenario affects your timeline.
watch-your-debts-literally.06adaf: Watch your debts literally burn away with beautiful animations as you make payments. Oddly satisfying and incredibly motivating.

your-debt-plans-and.bc13ba: Your debt plans and progress sync seamlessly across all your Apple devices via iCloud. Monitor your debt payoff journey from your iPhone, check progress on your iPad, or plan at your Mac—always in sync.
your-debts-are-indexed.57e591: Your debts are indexed with Spotlight on-device, so searching "car loan" finds the actual debt and jumps you straight to it.
